evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking change. tools/version.py is an internal build helper; its public contract is producing a version string that CMake consumes. The new fallback value YYYY.WW.0~0.nogit follows the same pattern as other generated versions and does not alter any API, CLI, config, or schema.
evidence.documentation: The module-level docstring in tools/version.py was updated to document the fallback case. The new unit test serves as an executable example of the behavior.
evidence.manual_release_testing: Not required. This change affects internal version computation only. CI already exercises this path: the docker-smoke-test workflow and the C++ server build workflow both run docker builds and pass, confirming the fallback works in practice. CI stamps .version before building, which still wins; the nogit fallback is the safety net for untagged trees with neither .git nor .version, an edge case that does not ship in the release.
evidence.post_approval_commits: Only one commit exists in the PR (6c7d4065). @superm1 approved at 2026-09-15T14:14:19Z against commit 6f46caa15a3372aa3a5c6b8fe347077d618a3ae3 (the squashed PR commit). There are zero commits added after approval; the approved commit is the only commit.
evidence.review: PR #3589 was reviewed and approved by @superm1 (MEMBER), whose subject area per contribute.md includes Docker and containers — directly relevant here. superm1 confirmed it was a real issue and noted that CI already does the same thing (stamps .version before building, see c47aa2a491e8c8c6e07a895eaad88b27452f2bb2). No inline review comments were filed. The author confirmed in a comment that a PR down the stack reproduces the failure and this branch resolves it.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The new in_git_work_tree() helper only runs git rev-parse and falls back to False on failure. No network calls, credential handling, or code execution paths introduced.
evidence.tests: A new test method test_without_git_falls_back_to_dated_placeholder was added to test/test_version.py. It creates a plain temporary directory (no git repo), calls version.get_version(), and asserts the returned string matches the expected YYYY.WW.0~0.nogit format. No existing tests were weakened or deleted.

subject: tools/version.py: fall back to a dated placeholder outside a git work tree (#3589)
summary: Falls back to a dated placeholder version string when version.py runs outside a git work tree (e.g., a plain docker build context), preventing CMake from aborting.
verdict_reason: Focused fix with subject-matter-approved review, adequate test coverage for the new code path, and no release surface impact.
